about.title: About Me
about.bio1: Hello! My name is Victor, I'm a Software Engineering student at FIAP, with practical experience in Full Stack development and a solid foundation in C++ acquired at UFBA.
about.bio2: I work on developing APIs, databases, and web applications, focusing on creating solutions that generate real impact and accelerate my technical and professional evolution.
about.bio3: I hold certifications such as CSA – Certified System Administrator and CIS – Customer Service Management. My hard skills include technologies like Node.js, Java, Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, as well as frameworks like Express.js, React, and Bootstrap.
about.bio4: I have experience with databases like MySQL, Oracle SQL Developer, and AWS RDS, as well as DevOps tools and practices like GitHub, Docker, Postman, and Azure DevOps.
about.bio5: I currently work as a Technical Consultant at AOOP (NTT DATA Company), where I have already worked on process automation for Azul Linhas Aéreas, implementing complex flows and integrations, always recognized for delivery quality.

project1.title: Victor Martins Portfolio
project1.description: Personal portfolio developed to demonstrate Full Stack Software Engineer skills, focusing on UX, modern design and performance.
project1.detailedDescription: Personal portfolio developed to demonstrate my skills as a Full Stack Software Engineer, with focus on user experience (UX), modern design and performance.
features: Hybrid & Modern Design - Layout combining Bento Grid for projects and vertical Timeline for journey/education
Internationalization (i18n) - Full support for Portuguese (PT), English (EN) and Spanish (ES)
Expanded Modals - Detailed project view without leaving the page, with video support, information tabs and galleries
Sound Feedback (UI Sounds) - Subtle sound effects on interactions (click, hover) for a more tactile experience
Smooth Animations - Fluid transitions using framer-motion and micro-interactions
Smart Resume Download - Automatic delivery of resume in English or Portuguese depending on selected language
Fully Responsive - Perfectly adapted for Mobile, Tablet and Desktop
Native Dark Mode - Interface designed with glassmorphism and vibrant colors on dark background
project1.challenges: The main challenge was creating a unique and memorable user experience, balancing modern design with performance. The i18n implementation with next-intl required careful structuring of translations and dynamic routing.

project2.title: Quintas de Sauípe D10
project2.description: Rental platform for a luxury house in Quintas de Sauípe, developed with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
project2.detailedDescription: Premium landing page developed to promote the rental of a high-standard house in the Quintas de Sauípe condominium. The project focuses on a rich visual experience, using smooth animations and modern design to attract potential clients and facilitate the booking process.
features: 4K Photo Gallery - Detailed high-fidelity view of all areas of the house
Responsive Design - Optimized navigation for smartphones, tablets, and desktops
Contact Integration - Floating buttons for direct booking via WhatsApp and Airbnb
Engaging Animations - Strategic use of Framer Motion to guide the user's eye
Performance Optimization - Fast loading of heavy images via Next.js Image
Strategic SEO - Implementation of metadata and semantic structure for organic visibility
project2.challenges: The main challenge was balancing the use of high-resolution images with exceptional loading performance. The solution involved advanced lazy loading techniques and native Next.js asset optimization, ensuring that the luxury of the house was conveyed without compromising speed.
